scope: Implement a segment-relative fixed-tape continuation adapter for one actual FOUR/base child boundary. Bind every reached PR2250 compact/monomial role to its current-node segment, save complete current roles and the exact return descriptor, run the child ABI, restore and erase local work, and return all heads without traversing or erasing arbitrary dirty ancestor prefixes. Prove this for arbitrary f/current payload extent and arbitrary ancestor extent, with a source-derived finite role inventory and no hidden whole-backing rewind.

first_bounded_fixture: Use the same real FOUR/base f=2 rank-3 boundary as the packet task, right/left compact slots and actual width (f-1)G, with current-node roles dirty and ancestor prefixes of lengths16,257,4096. Actually execute the inherited monomial/compact tape boundary under a segment view; supply the recursive child by an explicitly labelled oracle only where necessary. Compare local operation counts across ancestor sizes and restore exact role bytes/head origins.
success: Uniform segment/refinement invariant and literal count O(current volume*e^(1-a2)*polylog p) for this boundary, including origin installation, delimiters, descriptor size, every rewrite/rewind, child return and cleanup; source-reaching controls prove the old unbounded rewind/full-backing erase fails. Demonstrate nested two-level use, not merely a synthetic stack copy.
